## What's Changed

- Fix Elasticsearch index patterns whose indices map the time or sort field differently, and show clear messages instead of "unusable response" errors.
- Treat empty usernames and passwords as "no authentication" for every connector.
- Prometheus and VictoriaMetrics now return exact totals and histograms for large results, including empty queries, and load only the rows for the current page.
- Fix the Prometheus 3 connection test.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.4.1...0.4.2
